mechanism.en: A juncture for s is a configuration with one step after which s can still be had and one after which it cannot. Where s returns, every course from s to where s cannot be had again passes, up to double negation, a juncture at which it takes its losing step. Keeping only the steps after which s can still be had keeps s, holds every sub-process keeping s on its course, and removes exactly the losing steps; a process keeping s has no juncture for s on its course, however many options it has (witness Many). At a configuration with a step keeping s that is no juncture, no step can be refuted to keep it: a choice matters only at a juncture. Where a list holds the configurations and steps are decided, the juncture is found by search; finding the juncture of every loss of every process gives LPO. World, with a process; before D both courses balanced with the same formations present, a common start, and every formation the source has not reached responding through its couplings; the reader at one configuration x in both courses supplied: a reader the source has not reached by D, whose step at x is chosen from what it reads through its couplings up to D, takes the same step in both courses. Reading [AI reading, D25, D32, D43, D52]: keeping and losing at a juncture are one operation with no valuation.

condition.en: Where s returns, every course from s, or from a configuration that can have s, to one that cannot passes, up to double negation, a juncture at which it takes its losing step.

mechanism.en: The regime on webs: any number of conditions, each draw taken first, each giving a law of what is left of all. Where i gives nothing wherever nothing is left of j, i drains once j stays within its draw; in whole numbers it falls by its draw at every step and, the draw positive, is nothing within as many steps as its level, so j's end ends i. Along every chain of total dependence with positive draws on dependents the end of one ends everything downstream, a ring ending together or not at all, and a draw of nothing stops the cascade. Under mutual support (every giving rising with what is left of each) the order of states is kept, so raising a level never ends one that held; inhibition breaks that order (a witness). For finitely many listed conditions within a band under mutual support a run rests within the count times hi plus one steps, ending decided there, and each point of no return, the others given, is exact and does not rise as any other level rises. In a finite web read condition by condition, a run within a bound B repeats within (B + 1)^n steps, so ending is a finite check with no band; such a run need not rest (Relay.cycles, a witness); under mutual support each point of no return is exact and does not rise. mechanism.en: A target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled. Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target. "More than now" is met only by change, and met at every step it needs an open world, no list holding its configurations; "above all others" is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. On the World model, what stands listed at each step: where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. Under an undetermined law (any process) enough parts in two: some run comes to rest with its target met exactly where a reachable configuration meets the target and can stay; every run does exactly where every reachable configuration that can stay meets the target and every run from it settles. Staying and meeting everywhere do not give settling: with two configurations and every step allowed, the alternating run never settles. That the seeking is 无明 is a reading, filed apart (locked-seeking).

When runs settle is 08's: in a world that a list holds, some run from a configuration keeps changing exactly where a reachable change can be undone; that no run keeps changing does not give settling constructively; worlds that no list holds are outside these laws.
Targets met along a course rather than at a configuration (more than now), choices divided between the seeker and others, and probabilistic enough.

Through a reward's couplings, candidates are trained alike exactly where their levels are alike through them. Among laws a reward settles on (an optimum of that reward), a search improving a natural-number reward started at a settled law stays there, and under a reward at most B rests from every start by step B + 1; a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood's added rests are its implicit bias. Lean's Unfolds has chases: Says same (φ (n + 1)) (gap f (φ n)), so the next step says each step's gap by definition, and the mechanism says so too ('saying the last gap'). What holds (Unfolds.gap_new): no step says the gap of any later step, and each new step has a new gap. The home's sentence is not the source of the phrase. mechanism.en: Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap, so no family of claims says every reading. Under such a map, completing it step by step, each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap, is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns (not everything a later step says was said at an earlier one); with likeness transitive no two gaps are alike, and with it symmetric too no finite stock holds them. Revising a value by a map moving every value changes it at every step of its orbit; the liar is a rhythm with no still value, shown periodic for the two-valued negation only. With equality of values decided and both types inhabited, a family is complete exactly where all values are equal. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.

mechanism.en: With balance at the condition, the joint exchange departs from evenness by at most the gap to m on each side exactly where the next level lies between m and the present one: the bound is exactly no overshoot. Within it, opposing, the level settles at m. Beyond it an opposing exchange crosses m (a law, from above and from below), and with balance a joint exchange beyond the gap at every step from T leaves the level off m at every later step: overcorrecting at every step never comes to rest at m (a law, with no opposition asked). That the level goes between two values is a witness: a balanced exchange opposing the departure at every step and exceeding the gap at every step has its level alternate between 2 and 0 about m = 1, never 1. That such a course returns, and with what period, is stated of this witness only.

mechanism.en: Witnesses on the World. One unit cycles between two pools, the total stays one, every premise of the law of renewal holds and arising is unceasing: this course returns, the consumer arising at every odd step. In the cycle of Becoming.Flow nothing returns: its one condition stands at one throughout, formation n arises across step n and stays active, each taking one unit and giving one back, so the flow balances, every step is enclosed around the condition, the exchange recurs at arbitrarily late steps, and generation is unceasing and more without end. Each lacks dissipation: where a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it, arising is not unceasing, and an enclosed, balanced, dissipative world with finite censuses and embodied arising cannot be refuted to come to rest. A formation arising again and again on a condition a source renews (Oscillation) meets the depletion premise only vacuously. 'Unceasing' reads only that arising recurs at arbitrarily late steps.

mechanism.en: No premise on the unfolding: the list is the hypothesis each law writes in. A sequence a list holds revisits from every step on, and so does every run of every process whose configurations a list holds. Within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a determined law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, exactly where it keeps every possibility; a quantity that never falls along an orbit and rises at some step of it rules out a law that merges nothing. A course has at most N states exactly where it repeats from some step i with some period q + 1, i + q + 1 <= N; where the laws are functions, moves formed by a whole, a rest or a part held by a list repeat from some step with some period, start and period within the list's length. So there a period exists and is bounded by the list; which, is not said. Where runs part a bound on configurations bounds no course: free branching on two values is held by a list of two configurations, and one of its runs has a course through the map with no bound on its states (a witness). Becoming that keeps its whole history merges nothing and never returns, so it needs a carrier no list holds, and a present a list holds forgets. Under the successor nothing merges and no number returns.

Both rise with what is left of each (mutual support) and give nothing where nothing is left of the other; each alone ends from every level, while from two and three the run moves between two and three and three and two for ever, within three, neither ending, never still. It keeps no band from three up. Within a band the coupled step keeps, mutual support brings a run from the band to rest within 2 hi + 1 steps; without a band mutual support need not rest. What a bound does give, on a finite web read condition by condition (a list covering the conditions): a run within B comes back to an earlier state at some step at most (B + 1)^n and repeats from there. mechanism.en: A law on every balanced run of a relay, not a witness. Reading l steps late, the relay pushes M for a reading below a, pulls M for one above b and rests within. With a <= b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (l + 1)M <= b + 1, every balanced run from every start below a held for its first l + 1 steps settles in the band exactly where a + (l + 1)M <= b + 1. From a held start the relay crosses where its entry at x0 + kM, carried lM further, passes b, and settles where that stays within b. An upward crossing is followed by a downward one and that by an upward one, so after every step the level is somewhere above b and somewhere below a; the start held at a - 1 does this where b + 2 <= a + (l + 1)M. So for the relay, from a held start, the account has a condition and not only a witness of when a course passes both ends without end. That the level returns to one value, or with what period, is not stated: only that each end is passed at arbitrarily late steps. Balance at the condition and the relay are premises; that a given system is one is not shown.

Where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less. A map below the identity off zero closes within d turns, exactly, and merges. Monotone return maps settle within d turns where f d <= d. With whole-number factors a loop closes at once, keeps, or from a positive start exceeds every bound, never closing gradually; taking one off does close gradually. A self-loop of strength M has factor 1 + M; read on balanced flows, on a ring of two or more conditions with one positive strength on every link and a positive starting gap, one plus the product of strengths is strictly below a turn. That the exchanges respond to the gap by a map is a premise, taken as given; without it the gap need not be the course of any map.

In Slowing, a condition met again after ever longer gaps always returns and is never consumed, yet no cycle length bounds its return (a witness): a dependence's return need have no period. mechanism.en: Take a course keeping widening by name on the actual levels, what every formation supported from a step on requires fixed within a finite family of conditions. The family's stock passes every bound and rises at arbitrarily late steps (natural-number amounts); under the first law, the family without repetition, at arbitrarily late steps the rest gives it net or it is not closed; and a finite world under the first law, balanced on all its conditions from a step, has no such course. Under upkeep the course has ever more takers; with the family balanced on from a step its replenishment, and with bounded giving per entry its renewers, are bounded from no step on, entries of the present list counted with repetition. Under the World premises and requirements never loosening, along any continuation containing carrying on of the supported, what is supported descends, up to double negation, from what was supported at every earlier step or from a beginning between, a passing of support into a formation nothing supported continues into along it. So keeping opening needs, up to double negation, a beginning after every step, by name a passing of support; not conversely. Along every continuation containing carrying on while supported or passing support nothing keeps opening or keeps widening; where a list holding every condition any formation requires is dissipated on from a step, nothing keeps widening. The first two laws restate open-systems thermodynamics and maintenance scaling, the others are near-definitional, and none compares two courses; which actual courses meet the premises is not shown.

With the stock never rising and falling across each change, change does not recur without end. With the rest of the whole counted, every rise is given net by some relatum; under the first law a family without repetition that rises is given by the rest or is open; and, under the first law, a whole a list holds without repetition, the rest giving it nothing net from T on, stays within its stock at T and is not new at every step. It says rest cannot be refuted, not when it comes: naming, for every such finite world with activity decided, the step after which nothing arises gives LPO. Across such a step any change of standing lowers the total; with every relatum embodied and activity decided, and every step from T on enclosed, the total standing at T bounds the relata active together with the steps of change. The world need not be finite, but finitely many stand and act at each step. Each premise is needed, by a witness without it. The exchange does not recur under the census of what stands, balance, dissipation and enclosure alone (a negated recurrence). The eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness, and openness with them does not give arising without end (holding, a witness); every premise binding does not bring rest. Within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a run starts exactly where a course as long as the list starts, exactly where a course leading to a return starts, with no decision and no selection. That no run keeps changing does not give settling constructively: in a process of two configurations with no way back no run keeps changing, and every run from the first settling gives LPO. A run staying in every family that keeps moving, asked of every process, is exactly dependent choice. Worlds that no list holds are outside these laws; where branching is infinite, courses of every length need not give a run (the fan, a witness).

Under balance, uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps. Where a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it, arising is not unceasing; a closed cycle sustains it, and a tide renews with nothing arising: unceasing arising is strictly stronger than recurring renewal. Formations can arise one after another while drawing an unrenewed condition, and arising does not recur (a witness). A formation active exactly where supported, at a step and the next, does not arise across the step where every condition it required before is still required, its needs stay and every level stays: arising needs a change in what is read. Unceasing reads only that arising recurs at arbitrarily late steps, not more, diversity or complexity, and it depends on identity across steps.

A common number added to every offspring number leaves concordance and discordance unchanged and makes the next cohort larger by that number for each member. So within any horizon H, a course nonempty at H has its cohorts and terms through H shared by a course nonempty at every cohort and one empty from H + 2 on, and from a nonempty first cohort, terms zero from some step on are shared by a course that goes on and one that ends. On the other side of that boundary, terms positive at unboundedly many steps keep every cohort nonempty, and so does exact transmission of offspring number from t on with a positive term at t; exactness at t alone is not enough. Which side a course is on is not decided. (World, for lineages.) Where listed offspring continue their parents, a whole cohort degenerates only if a later cohort is empty, and exactly then where the census holds every continuation; so, from a nonempty cohort, a term positive at every nonempty cohort from it on leaves not every member of that cohort degenerating, and decides no point's region.
